huawei-cloud-mrs-redis-meta-check v1.0.1

- Checks Redis nodes-*.conf metadata files for 7 categories of integrity issues that can cause cluster failures.
- Detects errors in slot allocation, master/slave instance counts, file format, filename/port consistency, port relationships, master-slave relationships, and myself marker presence.
- Provides user guidance for file collection and selecting correct files for analysis.
- Ensures static, local-only file analysis with no cluster connectivity or credential requirements.
- Designed for both routine checks and troubleshooting Redis startup or connection anomalies.
